$comment: Checked-in OpenCode host contract (plan-23 step 1). Declares the shape of the mcp.<name> local-server entry that OpenCode's config.json accepts, so installer-generated entries can be validated against the host's actual schema rather than an inline assumption. See src/services/integrations/OpenCodeInstaller.ts (addOpenCodeMcpReference) and tests/integration/opencode-installer.test.ts.

entry.description: A single entry under the top-level `mcp` object, keyed by server name (claude-mem uses key `claude-mem`).

type.description: Server transport. claude-mem registers a local server launched by the plugin runtime.

command.description: Exec argv for a local server. OpenCode performs no ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} substitution, so both elements must be absolute (Rule B in install-paths.ts).

environment.description: Optional environment map passed to the local server process.
